gloss: attic; loft; space under the roof

definitions.gloss: attic; loft; space under the roof
definitions.explanation: The space between the ceiling of the top floor and the roof of a building. May be used for storage or converted into a living space.

examples.japanese: {屋根裏|やねうら}に{荷物|にもつ}をしまった。
examples.english: I stored luggage in the attic.

examples.japanese: {屋根裏|やねうら}を{部屋|へや}に{改装|かいそう}した。
examples.english: We converted the attic into a room.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{家|いえ}の{屋根裏|やねうら}から{昔|むかし}の{写真|しゃしん}や{手紙|てがみ}が{見|み}つかった。
examples.english: Old photos and letters were found in the attic of the old house.

notes:
{屋根裏|やねうら} is the space between the ceiling of the top floor and the roof. Composed of {屋根|やね} (roof) + {裏|うら} (back/underside).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {屋根裏|やねうら}{部屋|へや}: attic room (converted living space)
- {屋根裏|やねうら}{収納|しゅうのう}: attic storage
- {屋根裏|やねうら}に{上|あ}がる: to go up to the attic
- {屋根裏|やねうら}に{荷物|にもつ}をしまう: to store things in the attic

USAGE:
In Japanese houses, {屋根裏|やねうら} is commonly used for storage. Modern houses sometimes convert the space into a ロフト (loft) for living use. In older traditional houses, {屋根裏|やねうら} may be quite spacious.

RELATED WORDS:
- ロフト: loft (used living space under the roof)
- {天井裏|てんじょううら}: above the ceiling (similar concept, structural focus)
- {地下室|ちかしつ}: basement (opposite location in a building)
